subs.text: Jamie — your name, your photos, your hybrid coaching. Already built into a working platform.
A home for your brand, with coaching, race tools and community together.
The Zones — station prep, running and the race-day details athletes come back for.
Your story, with your own race imagery giving it some personality.
The Madrid finish shot is here. Free tools first, then a clear route into your coaching.
Events and race plans sit alongside the coaching, rather than getting lost in a feed.
The Warriors Wall — space for your community's race photos. Demo entries show the layout for now.
Ask Jamie — a dedicated place for training questions and race advice.
Coaching gets its own page — with the onward route into Find Your Edge, not a replacement for it.
Find a race-mate — doubles, mixed and relay partners have somewhere to find each other.
A practical community feature that gives athletes another reason to return.
Race Tools: the predictor gives athletes a place to explore their target finish time.
Your site becomes useful between race weekends, not just when someone wants a coaching link.
Split analyser — a place to break down a race and look for improvement opportunities.
A useful starting point for the next coaching conversation.
A results board for progress and race times. The demo shows the structure ready to populate.
Station prep — all eight stations, each with technique, pacing and coaching cues.
Your new sled push, rope pull and carry photos are wired into the relevant station guides.
Run Zone — your race running shot leads into pacing and compromised-running advice.
Taper Zone — the final week, organised clearly so athletes know what to focus on.
Race calendar — a central place to plan the event and the trip around it.
Race crew meetups — your community has somewhere to organise the social side of race day.
News and updates under your own name — a home for coaching notes and race recaps.
Your destinations in one place: Find Your Edge, MyProtein and the Red Bull Coaches Camp information.
Click Find Your Edge and the journey continues into your existing coaching app.
The MyProtein button links to their store; Red Bull links to their site. No discount code or commission is implied.
The platform brings those routes together while keeping your brand at the start of the journey.
Join the list — a direct way to keep in touch with people interested in your coaching.
Behind the public site: the Desk.
Coaching income, race costs and partner activity in a dashboard. These figures are demo data, not your accounts.
A place for the business side as well as the coaching side.
Your coaching, useful race tools and your community — all under your name.
Have a look around, Jamie. I'd love to hear what you think.
